candidates: When adding journal article citations or DOI references in RST documentation, always use the project's custom `:doi:` role (e.g., `:doi:\`Author et al., Journal vol, p. XXX (year). <10.xxxx/xxxxxx>\``) rather than plain URLs or bare DOI strings, for consistency with the rest of the documentation.

Do not mark an existing class or API as deprecated merely because a better alternative has been introduced; deprecation signals a concrete plan for future removal. If no removal is planned, prefer proposing a descriptive rename (e.g., reflecting the underlying algorithm name) in a dedicated follow-up PR, and in the meantime use a `.. note::` or `.. warning::` directive to document the limitations.
